name: 둥근 광고탑(빛바랜 포스터 — 글자 없음, 넓은 녹청 돔 뚜껑)
label: steampunk-city/sp-poster-column

answer.main_body: cylindrical advertising pillar with domed cap and posters
answer.evidence: The advertising column is capped by a rounded dome (rows 5–14) showing a foreshortened top surface with a downward-curving front rim (row 14) and a finial, as well as a multi-row visible base plinth ledge (rows 27–29).

The cylindrical advertising pillar is drawn entirely as a flat front elevation. The circular cylinder has completely straight horizontal lines (e.g. poster bottoms at row 21 and row 26) with no elliptical curvature or top-down perspective, and the dome cap is drawn in straight side profile/front view with no foreshortened top surface.

answer.main_body: advertising column (Morris column) with domed roof cap
answer.evidence: The dome cap displays its downward-sloping top surface across rows 5–11, and the bottom rim curves downward in an ellipse (rows 13–15) consistent with looking down from a 3/4 top-down angle. The base plinth also shows a curved top ledge at rows 27–28.

The cylindrical body, posters, and base are drawn with perfectly straight horizontal lines (rows 16, 22, 27) instead of the elliptical curves required for a 3/4 top-down view. The dome cap is drawn as a direct front silhouette with no visible top plane, making the entire structure a pure front elevation.
